source_audit.scope: Targeted primary-literature method review; no exhaustive global SOTA ranking; no local training or replication.

sources.title: V-JEPA 2.1
sources.supports: Dense spatial/temporal latent predictive learning; intermediate supervision and image/video training.
sources.limits: Visual predictive features do not establish online new-concept acquisition or correction.

sources.title: DINOv3
sources.supports: Reusable self-supervised dense visual features, including frozen-backbone downstream evaluation.
sources.limits: Large upstream training; semantic features are not a complete concept-learning agent.

sources.title: Object Concepts Emerge from Motion
sources.supports: Motion-derived instance grouping as a training signal without human masks.
sources.limits: Recent preprint; uses optical-flow models, clustering and large training data; object grouping is narrower than general concept induction.

sources.title: DINOSAUR
sources.supports: Object grouping trained by reconstructing pretrained self-supervised features.
sources.limits: Feature decoder is not full pixel reconstruction; object slots do not establish abstract concepts.

sources.title: Prototypical Networks
sources.supports: Learn embedding metric during meta-training; new class prototypes computed from support at test time.
sources.limits: Category learning within learned feature/metric assumptions; not arbitrary relational reasoning.

sources.title: Meta-learning for compositionality
sources.supports: Train across compositional episodes; frozen test weights interpret support examples and compose outputs.
sources.limits: Controlled pseudolanguage tasks, not natural multimodal lifelong concept acquisition.

sources.title: Latent Concept Disentanglement
sources.supports: Controlled analyses of latent intermediate concepts and inferred numerical task parameters; numerical models trained from scratch.
sources.limits: Factual bridge tasks often use already pretrained world knowledge; interpolation within studied families is not arbitrary new abstractions.

sources.title: RDB-PFN
sources.supports: Synthetic task pretraining supports relational in-context prediction on new databases.
sources.limits: Relational supervised prediction, not autonomous multimodal concept discovery; structured input prior matters.

sources.title: LatentMem
sources.supports: Raw trajectories stored externally; trained composer generates agent-conditioned continuous memory tokens; experiences appended at inference.
sources.limits: Latent read context is not an entirely latent evidence store; LLM multi-agent QA/code evidence, not general online concept formation.

sources.title: MemGen
sources.supports: Frozen reasoner plus separately trained trigger and weaver produce latent memory during reasoning.
sources.limits: Draws on implicit parametric memory, optionally retrieval; frozen reasoner alone does not prove all modules frozen or new-fact persistence.

sources.title: Titans
sources.supports: Online neural-memory learning with gradient-based fast memory updates.
sources.limits: Fast memory parameters change; not strict frozen-all-weights state-only acquisition.

sources.title: Coconut
sources.supports: Continuous hidden-state reasoning trained using a curriculum derived from language reasoning chains.
sources.limits: No mandatory textual intermediate inference, but trained language backbone and supervision; narrow tasks, not universal concept induction.

sources.title: Do Latent Tokens Think?
sources.supports: Perturbation/swap and biased/OOD experiments report shortcut reliance in studied Coconut-style variants.
sources.limits: Authors explicitly acknowledge no formal causal link and speculative mechanism explanations; not a refutation of all latent reasoning.

sources.title: Trained Persistent Memory for Frozen Encoder-Decoder LLMs
sources.supports: Pilot with frozen Flan-T5-XL, trained adapters and inference-time memory accumulation.
sources.limits: Single backbone/dataset; capacity-sensitive failures and weak stateless baseline. Feasibility pilot, not general SOTA proof.

sources.title: DreamerV3
sources.supports: Concurrent learning of latent world model, actor and critic from interaction; encoder/decoder are learned components.
sources.limits: Separate trained agents across tasks under common recipe; not one frozen model learning arbitrary new concepts.

sources.title: LeWorldModel
sources.supports: Joint latent encoder/predictor learning from pixels without reconstruction or pretrained encoder; anti-collapse regularization.
sources.limits: Narrow control environments; source snapshot supplied by HF references v1, latest arXiv v3 abstract checked separately. No all-domain concept learning or local feasibility claim.

sources.title: Searching Latent Program Spaces
sources.supports: Learned latent implicit programs; code inference and test-time search, including sampling and gradients on latent codes.
sources.limits: Programming-by-examples tasks; not demonstrated persistent multimodal concept acquisition/correction. Code optimization is different from backbone weight training.
